description_en: Removes IP addresses from an egress proxy IP address pool
description_zh: 从出口代理地址池移除IP地址
name: RemoveIpAddressesFromEgressProxyIpPool

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run and does not remove IP addresses from the IP address pool. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会从地址池删除地址。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy IP address pool from which you want to remove IP addresses
parameters.help_zh: 待移除 IP 地址的出口代理地址池 ID
parameters.name: egress_proxy_ip_pool_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP) to be removed. Specify this parameter only when the address type (AddressType) of the IP address pool is Internet
fields.help_zh: 待移除的弹性公网 IP（EIP）实例 ID。仅当地址池的地址类型（AddressType）为 Internet 时填写
fields.name: eip_allocation_id

fields.help_en: The private IPv4 address to be removed. Specify this parameter only when the address type (AddressType) of the IP address pool is Intranet
fields.help_zh: 待移除的私网 IPv4 地址。仅当地址池的地址类型（AddressType）为 Intranet 时填写
fields.name: private_ipv4_address

fields.help_en: The list of IP addresses to be removed
fields.help_zh: 待移除的 IP 地址列表
fields.name: ip_addresses

fields.help_en: The zone ID. The zone must already exist in the egress proxy IP address pool
fields.help_zh: 可用区 ID。需为该出口代理地址池已有的可用区
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The zone mappings, which are used to specify the zones from which you want to remove IP addresses and the IP addresses to be removed
parameters.help_zh: 可用区映射列表，用于指定要从哪些可用区移除 IP 地址以及待移除的地址
parameters.name: zone_mappings
